description: In email/set.rs create_one_email, from_email is taken directly from the JMAP EmailAddress.email string (which may be any email address) and embedded verbatim into the From: header of the synthesised article via format\!(). The strip_crlf call removes \r and \n but does not handle other RFC 5322 From: header escaping (e.g. display name quoting, non-ASCII characters, or excessively long addresses). A from address containing a colon followed by spaces (e.g. 'a: b@c.com') would produce a malformed From header. RFC 5322 requires the From field to contain a valid mailbox-list; raw injection without addr-spec validation is not safe.
title: Email/set create: from_email injected into article without MIME encoding
